race.comment: SORT CHA MESS (1) is the one to beat after measuring up well at Doomben, where he led and was only run down by one late. His Moree CL3 win prior was decisive. Has enough pace to offset the wide alley and should prove tough to reel in. DEEP TIARA (4) never looked likely last time here when getting too far back but was a good winner two back in what's proven a hot form reference. Draws kind and can rebound sharply. SHAHAR (9) is another danger. She was well-backed when fourth here last start and her narrow Sunshine Coast second to Snitzstream two back reads well, especially with her strong jockey association. BETTER SWEET (3) drops out of a CL4 after charging home at Ipswich and can cause a late scare on the quick back-up, if they overdo it in front.
